annotations.title: Net-profit cross-chain arb & tranche execution planner

description: [$0.04] Trigger When: sizing cross-chain DEX arbitrage after all fees. Workflow Outcome: verifies dual-chain RPCs, deducts gas, bridge, and slippage costs, and outputs a tranche plan. Do not use for DeFi yield pool ranking (use defi_yield_pools) or single-token snapshots (use token_market_snapshot). `source_chain` and `destination_chain` must differ, and `profitable_after_costs` turns `false` whenever gas+bridge+slippage exceed spread. Live DEX/RPC, read-only non-custodial plan; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.

destination_chain.description: Destination EVM chain (must differ from source_chain)

max_slippage_bps.description: Maximum slippage tolerance in basis points (5-500)

session_token.description: Optional prepaid session token (x402s_...) from https://apix402data.com/pay after the 10-call free preview.

source_chain.description: Source EVM chain (base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism)
